title: Playback Subtitle Language Default Policy
problem: Playback can honor explicit subtitle stream selection, but has no request-scoped language/default policy for multi-subtitle HLS subtitle groups.

evidence.summary: Opened a durable lane for request-scoped playback subtitle language/default selection after subtitle sidecar serving, HLS subtitle renditions, and audio language defaults shipped.
Added request-scoped preferred subtitle languages, deterministic playback subtitle selection precedence, and normalized subtitle language preferences in request identity.
Exposed preferred subtitle languages through the public HLS playlist query, defaulted the selected subtitle rendition, preserved explicit subtitle stream precedence, and updated OpenAPI/SDK/docs.

Verified and closed the request-scoped playback subtitle language/default policy lane, updating architecture/workstream docs and splitting persisted settings, UI controls, OCR/burn-in/ASS shaping, addon readiness, LL-HLS, DASH, DRM, and offline sync as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: The request-scoped playback subtitle language/default policy first slice is complete. Open follow-on workstreams for persisted user settings, UI controls, OCR/burn-in/ASS shaping, addon late-subtitle readiness, LL-HLS, DASH, DRM, offline sync, or richer language metadata normalization.
